tables.sql: SELECT 1 AS "id", CAST(5000.00 AS DECIMAL(7, 2)) AS "amount", CAST(15 AS DECIMAL(10, 0)) AS "whole", CAST('KING' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS "name", CAST('ab' AS CHAR(3)) AS "code", CAST('free' AS VARCHAR) AS "free", CAST(TIMESTAMP '2021-03-04 12:34:56.789' AS TIMESTAMP(3)) AS "ts3", CAST(TIMESTAMP '2021-03-04 12:34:56' AS TIMESTAMP) AS "ts", CAST(TIME '12:34:56' AS TIME(0)) AS "t0" FROM (VALUES (1))
